mapping_policy: Official SFZ numeric roots preferred. Filename octave conventions learned only from consistent official mappings in same source folder.
Key ranges divide gaps between recorded roots at semitone midpoints and do not extend beyond recorded minimum/maximum; unpitched sources trigger only MIDI60 at native speed.
Velocity labels are ordinal: available levels per root divide1..127 evenly. These are derived mappings, not exact upstream velocity curves.
Explicit RR tokens sort takes; deterministic filename cycling for collisions. Articulations/sections/registers remain separate presets and do not inflate unique instrument count.
All presets use neutral processing; sample release inherited from first official mapping when known, otherwise0.05s. No invented sounds.

SFZ loops, keyswitches, crossfades, end markers and other unlisted opcodes are not imported; offset/tune/gain/attack/release use the chosen non-keyswitch, non-Quiet official mapping where available. Original notes and recordings remain available.
